entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We're down to only one day left[n]of the year.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I know it's sudden, but we're gonna[n]throw a year-end party tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Are you organizing this, Futaba-[n]chan? Thank you for letting us[n]know.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Sojiro's making New Year's Eve[n]soba noodles for us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In that case, would it be all right if[n]we met up in the evening?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Go ahead. The whole place[n]is reserved anyway.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Morgana and Futaba already[n]covered it, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She really helped him out[n]in that Palace before.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And it's New Year's Eve, so it's not[n]like she'll be busy at practice.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's your job to contact her.
